name: drag-and-drop-list
description: A source-owned Dioxus-only Drag And Drop List component for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` per statics/catalogs/dioxus-components.json and tracked in statics/component_compatibility.json, not shadcn parity. Pointer-drag list reordering that reuses the roving-focus collection infrastructure already imported for Select. Keyboard reordering (Enter to lift/drop, Arrow keys to move, Escape to cancel, Delete/Backspace to remove) is the always-tested accessible path. Native pointer/mouse drag-and-drop is compiled and wired but not independently browser-verified -- a named risk carried since the M3 migration queue, the same open question as Slider's unverified desktop pointer-capture behavior.
documentation.accessibility: No dedicated APG "Drag and Drop" pattern exists; each item is a keyboard-operable (single-tab-stop roving tabindex) `<li aria-roledescription="sortable item" aria-grabbed>`, the list is `<ul aria-roledescription="sortable list" aria-describedby>` pointing at visually-hidden instructions, and every lift/move/drop/cancel is announced through a `role="status" aria-live="assertive"` live region (`packages/adico-primitives/src/drag_and_drop_list.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: Enter lifts/drops an item, Arrow keys move it, Escape cancels, Delete/Backspace removes it -- the always-tested primary interaction path. Native pointer/mouse HTML5 drag-and-drop is also implemented but not independently browser-verified.
